name: ECOVACS
headline: ECOVACS ownership, service-robot portfolio and integrated supply chain
description: A source-backed profile separating the ECOVACS Robotics brand from the listed group and its Tineco subsidiary, with products, manufacturing and channel strategy.
metaDescription: ECOVACS company profile: ownership, Tineco relationship, leadership, products, manufacturing, channels and competitive strategy.
disclaimer: World Clean Biz is an independent industry publication and is not affiliated with ECOVACS or Tineco. This profile focuses on ECOVACS Robotics; Tineco product facts are identified as group-level context, not ECOVACS-brand facts.

ownership.summary: ECOVACS Robotics is the service-robot brand of Shanghai-listed Ecovacs Robotics Co., Ltd. The 2025 annual report names Suzhou Chuangling Smart Investment Management Co., Ltd. as controlling shareholder and Qian Dongqi and David Cheng Qian as actual controllers. Tineco is a separate consumer brand inside the same listed group through wholly owned subsidiaries; its wet-and-dry appliances should not be presented as ECOVACS-branded products.

productPortfolio.name: DEEBOT robot vacuums
productPortfolio.positioning: The core residential service-robot line, spanning vacuuming, mopping and multifunction station formats.

productPortfolio.name: WINBOT window-cleaning robots
productPortfolio.positioning: A specialist home service-robot category extending ECOVACS beyond floors.

productPortfolio.name: GOAT robotic lawn mowers
productPortfolio.positioning: Outdoor service robots aimed at residential lawn care.

productPortfolio.name: DEEBOT PRO commercial cleaning robots
productPortfolio.positioning: B2B vacuuming and scrubbing systems for offices, retail, healthcare, transport and industrial sites.

manufacturingSupplyChain: The 2025 annual report says the listed company mainly uses self-production and has built in-house capabilities from key components through finished robots.

Group-level upstream assets include motor and drive-component production plus a 2 GWh polymer lithium-ion battery project designed to supply customized pouch-cell solutions to both ECOVACS and Tineco.
The filing treats Tineco subsidiaries, ECOVACS home and commercial robotics entities, overseas sales companies and component businesses as distinct legal units within the consolidated group.
marketsChannels: ECOVACS and Tineco each use diversified online and offline sales systems in China and overseas; channel facts in the listed-company report can therefore be group-level rather than ECOVACS-brand-only.
The ECOVACS brand operates in China and established overseas markets including the United States, Europe and Japan.
Commercial robotics adds a direct B2B route. At Interclean Amsterdam 2026, ECOVACS showed three DEEBOT PRO models and announced agreements with European customers.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: ECOVACS spans residential floor, window and lawn robots plus commercial cleaning, supported by online and offline consumer channels and a developing B2B route. The listed group's self-production and component integration provide supply-chain leverage, while Tineco supplies a separate second growth engine. Strategic pressure comes from keeping those brand boundaries clear and turning breadth into product leadership as Roborock and Dreame compress launch cycles, premium features spread downward and ECOVACS invests upstream in capital-intensive components.

developments.title: Listed group reports 2025 growth and confirms brand structure
developments.summary: Ecovacs Robotics Co., Ltd. reported RMB 19.04 billion of 2025 revenue and described a dual-brand model: ECOVACS service robots and Tineco intelligent home appliances, supported by a mainly self-produced supply chain.

developments.title: Commercial robotics expands in Europe
developments.summary: ECOVACS Commercial Robotics debuted at Interclean Amsterdam with DEEBOT PRO scrubbing and vacuuming systems and said it signed strategic agreements with European customers.

developments.title: Group details vertically integrated and greener production
developments.summary: ECOVACS' sustainability update described onsite solar generation at group factories, new facilities for ECOVACS and Tineco and a vertically integrated supply chain.

developments.title: ECOVACS marks 25 years from OEM to multi-brand manufacturer
developments.summary: The company traced its development from a Suzhou factory in 1998 to a global group with the ECOVACS Robotics and Tineco brands, while identifying 2006 as the ECOVACS brand launch.
